total.description: Total PMs matching the filters (all pages).

total_pages.description: Number of pages for this query.

has_more.description: True if there are more pages after this one.

due_from.description: Earliest due date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if none.

due_to.description: Latest due date applied (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); null if none.

filters.description: Normalized filters applied, by parameter name.

items.description: PMs in this page, ordered by nextdate. Only the requested fields are present, plus due_date (extdate or nextdate) when both are returned; dates are yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss in server time.

error.description: Present only when the request is invalid. No other field is returned.
